name: SplitScreen Co-op
description: Two player co-op with splitscreen for the base game, or up to four players sharing two or four cameras if using Jolly Co-op.<LINE><LINE>Supports players splitting up far away and sleeping in different shelters (not fully supported if using Jolly). Currently, both players will still wake up in the same shelter.<LINE><LINE>Originally by Henpemaz, forked by Orsa for newer game versions and bugfixing.
